example.en: The new salesperson's performance in her first month was above the norm.
example.zh: 這名新來的銷售員第一個月的表現高於一般水準。

example.en: I'm in charge of the internship's outreach program to college students.
example.zh: 我負責大學生實習的外展服務計畫。

example.en: From its inception, the e-reader gained high market share.
example.zh: 電子閱讀器從一開始就獲得相當高的市占率。

example.en: Disruption in the power supply sometimes happens in this country.
example.zh: 這個國家偶爾會停電。

example.en: Restaurant Tan Long offers traditional local dishes with modern twists.
example.zh: 壇隆餐廳提供融入現代巧思的當地傳統料理。

example.en: The board is discussing a realignment of our company's organization.
example.zh: 董事會正在討論公司組織重組。

example.en: The CEO's proposal broke the stalemate and the deal was finalized.
example.zh: 執行長的提議打破了僵局，交易終於定案。

example.en: The employees are worried about the implications of the planned merger.
example.zh: 員工擔心合併計畫所造成的可能影響。

example.en: Every year before the final match, over-the-top extravaganzas are staged.
example.zh: 每年進行總決賽之前，都會先舉行一場浮誇的盛大表演。

example.en: Our company is now at a critical juncture: whether to stay within the domestic market or expand abroad.
example.zh: 我們公司正面臨選擇留守國內市場或進軍海外的重要關頭。

example.en: Customers are encouraged to switch to online statements.
example.zh: 鼓勵顧客改用網路對帳單。

example.en: The brokers have the drive to close deals at a very high rate.
example.zh: 這群經紀人幹勁十足，迅速完成交易。

example.en: The president always values helpful input from employees on improving the workplace.
example.zh: 董事長總是很重視員工為改善工作環境所提出的意見。

example.en: Doctor Bobson provided feedback on the new surgical equipment.
example.zh: 鮑伯森醫生為新的手術設備提供了意見回饋。

example.en: It is against company regulations to wear shorts to work.
example.zh: 穿著短褲上班違反公司的規定。

example.en: I think my only shortcoming is a lack of experience in management.
example.zh: 我認為我唯一的缺點就是缺乏管理經驗。

example.en: The state government is now struggling to reduce budget deficits.
example.zh: 州政府正努力減少預算赤字。

example.en: Airline staff apologized to passengers for their delayed departure inconvenience.
example.zh: 航空公司的員工為航班誤點造成的不便向旅客致歉。

example.en: The City-Go Pass provides an easier way to cover daily commuting fares.
example.zh: 這張 City-Go 通行票讓大家支付每日通勤費用更方便。

example.en: The sales manager made a comparison between the two graphs.
example.zh: 銷售經理將兩張圖表做比較。

example.en: Ignorance is an obstacle to progress.
example.zh: 無知是進步的絆腳石。

example.en: Camille's position as quality control manager gives her a broad scope of authority.
example.zh: 品管經理一職賦予卡蜜兒很大的權力。

example.en: Beth read only a portion of the contract but signed it anyway.
example.zh: 貝絲只讀了一部分的合約，但還是簽了名。

example.en: Can you see any negative aspects of the plan?
example.zh: 你看得出這項計畫有什麼缺點嗎？

example.en: The president has a clear perception of the company's weakness.
example.zh: 董事長對於公司的弱點瞭若指掌。

example.en: Thailand had an enormous rice harvest this year.
example.zh: 今年泰國稻米大豐收。

phrases.phrase: take the initiative in + V-ing / to + V

example.en: The assistant manager took the initiative in trying to solve the problem.
example.zh: 襄理率先嘗試解決問題。

example.en: Only Ms. Hanson has the vision and the drive to make the project successful.
example.zh: 只有漢森小姐具備促使這項企劃成功的遠見和幹勁。

example.en: I have no particular preference for drinks.
example.zh: 我沒有特別偏好的飲料。

example.en: The company has established criteria for employee evaluations.
example.zh: 公司制定了員工績效評估標準。

example.en: In order to receive a Social Security number, you must present your birth certificate.
example.zh: 為取得社會安全碼，你必須出示出生證明。

example.en: Thank you for your kind reminder.
example.zh: 謝謝你的善意提醒。

example.en: The art gallery relies heavily on guest patronage for its operating funds.
example.zh: 這間美術館的營運資金極度仰賴訪客的光顧。

example.en: Our CEO prefers to do business with acquaintances and friends.
example.zh: 我們執行長比較喜歡跟熟人及朋友做生意。

example.en: The resort chain offers exceptional hospitality in over 100 cities worldwide.
example.zh: 這座連鎖度假村在世界各地一百多個城市提供優良的餐旅服務。

example.en: The CEO had pity for the laid-off workers in the process of downsizing.
example.zh: 執行長很同情在組織縮編過程中遭到解雇的員工。

example.en: Avery performs her job duties with great enthusiasm.
example.zh: 艾芙里滿懷熱忱盡忠職守。

example.en: The athlete is on a quest for the gold medal at the Olympics.
example.zh: 這名運動員想在奧運上得到金牌。

headword.meaning_zh: 名 努力，盡力 / 動 努力，盡力

example.en: We must make every endeavor to win back our market share.
example.zh: 我們必須竭盡全力奪回市占率。

example.en: The successful project was the result of an evolution of many good ideas.
example.zh: 這項成功的企劃是改良了許多好點子而有的成果。

example.en: Although the office moved to another state, the staff found it easy to adjust to the transition.
example.zh: 雖然辦公室遷到了另一州，員工認為適應這段過渡期還算容易。

example.en: Our safety procedures are in compliance with the state regulations.
example.zh: 我們的安全程序符合州政府的法規。

example.en: In the provincial city, a cluster of IT companies has formed over the past decade.
example.zh: 十年來，許多資訊科技公司群聚在這座省級城市。

example.en: The manager set a new sales quota for salespersons.
example.zh: 經理為銷售員制定新的目標銷售額。

example.en: There is a wonderful array of food and drinks on the table.
example.zh: 桌上擺滿豐盛的食物和飲料。

example.en: The mobile movie player was moved relatively quickly to a prototype phase.
example.zh: 那款行動電影播放器很快就進入製作原型的階段。

example.en: Our school offers a broad spectrum of classes for foreign language learners.
example.zh: 我們學校提供各式各樣的外語學習課程。

example.en: A growing fraction of store customers are buying from the vegetarian section.
example.zh: 在素食區購物的顧客比例逐漸提高。

headword.meaning_zh: 名 大多數；大量 / 形 大量的

example.en: The bulk of company branches are in Southeast Asia and Europe.
example.zh: 公司大多數的分部設在東南亞和歐洲。

headword.meaning_zh: 股份；利害關係；賭注；風險

example.en: Pauline invested €11 million into the startup, giving her a 53 percent stake.
example.zh: 寶琳對這間新創公司投資 1,100 萬歐元，取得 53% 的股份。

example.en: Midtown Conference Hall is an ideal venue for large business or association gatherings.
example.zh: 市中心會議廳是大型企業或協會聚會的理想場所。

example.en: Guards patrol the building parking lot, lobby and other premises at night.
example.zh: 警衛在晚上巡邏大樓停車場、大廳和其他場所。

example.en: Separate receptacles for discarded glass, paper, and plastic are set up throughout the building.
example.zh: 整棟大樓皆設有廢玻璃、紙類和塑膠的回收桶。

example.en: Zoo visitors may pick up attraction literature at the main gate.
example.zh: 動物園的訪客可在大門取得景點導覽簡介。

example.en: Negotiators from both firms agreed to a basic contract framework.
example.zh: 兩家公司的協商代表在基本的合約架構上達成共識。

example.en: We are more technologically advanced than our predecessors.
example.zh: 我們的技術比前人更先進。

example.en: The CEO retired, leaving a legacy of corporate success.
example.zh: 執行長將他輝煌的企業傳承下去後便功成身退。

headword.meaning_zh: 名 前提；先決條件 / 形 不可或缺的

example.en: An MBA degree is a prerequisite for the managerial position.
example.zh: 取得企管碩士學位是擔任管理階層的先決條件。

phrases.meaning_zh: 讚揚 A；向 A 致敬

example.en: The Developer of the Year Award is a tribute to cutting-edge IT firms.
example.zh: 年度開發商獎是表揚尖端資訊科技公司的一份榮耀。

example.en: There was no foundation in the supervisor's objections.
example.zh: 主管的反對毫無根據。

example.en: Martin's intuition told him that he should not accept the job offer.
example.zh: 馬丁的直覺告訴他不該接受這份工作。

example.en: All legal agreements require close scrutiny before signing them.
example.zh: 所有法律協議都必須在簽署前仔細檢查內容。

example.en: It takes a certain amount of skill and aptitude to do the job well.
example.zh: 做好這份工作需要一定的技巧和天賦。

example.en: Frances had the privilege of going to Europe on her business trip.
example.zh: 法蘭西絲享有前往歐洲出差的特權。

example.en: The CEO told the staff to have dignity when performing their duties.
example.zh: 執行長告訴員工履行職責之際也要保有尊嚴。

example.en: Her first novel became the literary phenomenon of the decade.
example.zh: 她的第一本小說轟動了當代的文壇。

example.en: The production department plans for multiple contingencies, such as raw material shortages.
example.zh: 生產部門為原物料短缺等突發事件做好因應計畫。

example.en: Please look over the agreement to make sure there isn't a discrepancy in the terms.
example.zh: 請詳閱協議，確保條款沒有矛盾之處。

example.en: Our overseas investment plan seemed to have no flaws.
example.zh: 我們的海外投資計畫看來沒什麼瑕疵。

headword.meaning_zh: 名 重擔；負擔 / 動 加負擔於…

example.en: Some men believe that it is a burden to take care of a family.
example.zh: 有些男人認為照顧家庭是個重擔。

example.en: We always hire or promote staff without any individual bias.
example.zh: 我們從不帶個人偏見雇用或提拔員工。

example.en: Neal had to quit his job because he was suffering from severe fatigue.
example.zh: 由於尼爾飽受極度疲勞所苦，不得不辭掉工作。

example.en: Our company is now in a terrible plight, as it has lost substantial market share.
example.zh: 我們公司喪失了龐大的市占率，現在的處境非常艱辛。

example.en: The government can't seem to come up with a remedy for the ailing economy.
example.zh: 政府似乎想不出任何補救辦法，以挽救低迷經濟。

example.en: Proximity to the railway terminal made Greenhills a prime residential area.
example.zh: 鄰近火車站的優點讓格林希爾變成高級住宅區。

example.en: We'd like you to serve as a liaison between the R&D and production divisions.
example.zh: 我們想請你擔任研發部門與生產部門之間的聯絡人。

example.en: The accounting section set a new protocol for reimbursing expenses.
example.zh: 會計部門制定了經費報銷的新規範。

example.en: I have a scheduling conflict this Friday.
example.zh: 我這週五有行程撞期。

example.en: The restaurant is well-known for its relaxed ambience and splendid food.
example.zh: 這間餐廳以輕鬆的氛圍與美食聞名。

headword.meaning_zh: 名 誘惑；吸引 / 動 誘惑

example.en: This booklet is a great introduction to the allure of Florence.
example.zh: 這本小冊子將佛羅倫斯介紹的很有魅力。

example.en: Get away from the hustle and bustle of the city with Weekend Resorts.
example.zh: 歡迎來到週末度假村，遠離都市的喧囂。

example.en: Investors are demanding full disclosure of the financial details.
example.zh: 投資人要求公開完整的財務細節。

example.en: The mystery novel loses momentum toward the end.
example.zh: 那本懸疑小說到最後草草結尾。

example.en: CFO Roslyn Harper has significant leverage with the board of directors.
example.zh: 財務長蘿絲琳．哈普對董事會有著舉足輕重的影響力。

example.en: Julius has a preoccupation with languages, studying Arabic, Russian and Chinese daily.
example.zh: 朱利斯全神貫注地學習語言，天天讀阿拉伯文、俄文和中文。

headword.meaning_zh: 名 剩餘；盈餘 / 形 過剩的

example.en: The farmers had a surplus of grain last year, but this year the supply is low.
example.zh: 去年農民還有剩餘的穀物，但今年的產量並不多。

example.en: The electrician had to wear a special outfit when performing his duties.
example.zh: 電工在工作時必須穿上特殊的全套服裝。

example.en: Convention turnout was high, with people drawn to the exciting exhibits.
example.zh: 會議的到場人數很多，許多人深受激動人心的展品吸引。

example.en: A clerical oversight left some important figures off the quarterly report.
example.zh: 文書工作的疏忽導致季度報告漏了一些重要數據。

example.en: All decisions are left to the manager's discretion.
example.zh: 所有決定全交由經理定奪。

example.en: Our dishes are all made from organic ingredients.
example.zh: 本店料理皆使用有機食材製作。

example.en: James is an energetic worker and has an appetite for learning.
example.zh: 詹姆斯是個精力充沛的員工，而且求知若渴。

headword.meaning_zh: 展示優點的場合；玻璃陳列櫃

example.en: The convention is a showcase of the latest video games and entertainment software.
example.zh: 這場大會是展示最新電玩遊戲和娛樂軟體的絕佳場合。

example.en: Let's celebrate the company's 100th anniversary with great fanfare!
example.zh: 讓我們盛大慶祝公司的一百週年紀念日吧！

example.en: Could you check this document as there may still be some typos?
example.zh: 能否請你檢查這份文件，看看有沒有哪裡打錯字？

example.en: The theme of today's seminar is resilience in difficult business situations.
example.zh: 今天的研討會主題是：如何在艱難的景氣下維持韌性。

adjective.meaning_zh: 迅速恢復精力的；有彈性的

example.en: The odds are that the candidate will decline our offer.
example.zh: 這名求職者可能會拒絕我們的錄取通知。

example.en: The production manager is a strong proponent of on-site employee training.
example.zh: 生產經理強烈支持員工在職培訓。

example.en: You can negotiate with the proprietor on the price of his property for sale.
example.zh: 你可以跟業主協商房產的售價。

example.en: The concert will last approximately 4 hours including one 20-minute intermission.
example.zh: 音樂會總長約為四小時，包含中場休息 20 分鐘。
